meta.interaction: Hover offset transitions, inset shadow focus states, and press-down scale animations.

items.name: action-hint
items.title: Action Hint
items.description: Wrapper that floats a small label above a button to confirm what the click did.

meta.interaction: Clicking the button pops a short message such as Copied above it, which drifts upward and fades out after a moment; only the newest message is ever on screen.

items.name: action-search-bar

items.description: Command-palette search field that lists matching actions with icons, shortcuts and type labels.

meta.interaction: Focusing the field drops the action list open and the rows stagger in one after another; typing filters the list as you go, and the magnifier at the end of the field flips up to a send arrow once there is text.

items.name: animated-accordion
items.title: Animated Accordion
items.description: Vertical stack of photo panels, each with a headline, where the open one shows its full copy and two buttons.

meta.interaction: Clicking a panel springs it open to full height while its photo settles and brightens, the heading grows, and the paragraph and buttons stagger in below; hovering a closed panel nudges it a little taller as a preview.

items.name: animated-hover-card
items.title: Animated Hover Card
items.description: Tall gradient card with a title and a subtitle that stays hidden until you hover.

meta.interaction: Hovering the card reveals the subtitle one character at a time, each letter dropping into place a beat after the one before it.

items.name: animated-link
items.title: Animated Link
items.description: An interactive link component supporting 13 premium hover variants including custom clipping masks, SVG sine waves, and text marquee animations.

meta.interaction: Hover text fill, SVG loops, marquee transition, doodle draw underline, overline, and dash arrow reveals.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Scrollable list of rows that appear as they come into view, with the top and bottom edges fading out.

meta.interaction: Rows grow and fade in as you scroll them into view and shrink back out as they leave; hovering or clicking a row selects it, and the arrow keys walk the selection up and down, scrolling it into view.

items.name: animated-path
items.title: Animated Path
items.description: An animated logo component that draws the paths smoothly using Framer Motion.

meta.interaction: On initial render, the logo paths are drawn and filled sequentially.

items.name: apple-spotlight
items.title: Apple Spotlight
items.description: A beautiful search component inspired by macOS Spotlight.

meta.interaction: Click the trigger to open a macOS-style search overlay; type to filter results.

items.name: ascii-converter
items.title: Ascii Converter
items.description: Two-pane tool that redraws an uploaded image as ASCII art, with controls for detail, character set and colour.

meta.interaction: Dropping in or picking an image redraws it as text in the right pane; dragging the detail slider, changing the character set or flipping the invert and colour switches updates the art straight away, and the divider between the panes can be dragged to resize them.

items.name: attractor
items.title: Attractor
items.description: Physics field where the elements you drop in are pulled toward a fixed point and pushed away by the cursor.

meta.interaction: The elements fall in and clump around the attractor point on load, then scatter as the pointer sweeps through them and drift back once it moves away; individual ones can be picked up and flung by dragging.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: Full-bleed backdrop of soft banded aurora light behind whatever you put in it.

meta.interaction: Runs on its own — the bands of colour drift slowly across the frame in an endless loop and do not react to the pointer.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: A dynamic stack of overlapping user avatars featuring custom tooltip display variants that track hover directions or coordinates with spring dynamics.

meta.interaction: Hover animations: spring-tilt (follows coordinate movements), spring-box (tilts the box container), and slide-blur (directional blur reveal).

items.name: award-carousel
items.title: Award Carousel
items.description: Row of laurel-wreath award badges above the matching quote and a row of dots.

meta.interaction: Hovering a badge brings it to full strength and dims the others, then steps the quote underneath across to that award one item at a time, with the dots sliding along to match.

items.name: background
items.title: Background
items.description: Full-screen hero image with a tint overlay, loaded at whichever size suits the viewport.

meta.interaction: Static layout — the image is picked to match the screen width on load and does not respond to input.

items.name: background-beams
items.title: Background Beams
items.description: Backdrop of thin curved lines sweeping diagonally across the frame, each lit by a travelling blue-to-purple glow.

meta.interaction: Runs on its own — glints of light crawl along the lines at staggered speeds and restart forever, with no reaction to the pointer.

items.name: background-boxes
items.title: Background Boxes
items.description: Backdrop grid of empty cells with faint plus marks at the intersections.

meta.interaction: Hovering a cell floods it with a random pastel colour instantly, and it clears again as the pointer moves on to the next one.

items.name: background-gradient
items.title: Background Gradient
items.description: Card wrapper ringed by a four-colour radial gradient with a blurred glow behind it.

meta.interaction: Runs on its own — the gradient slides back and forth around the edge of the card in a slow loop, and the outer glow brightens while the pointer is over it.

items.name: backlight
items.title: Backlight
items.description: Wrapper that casts a blurred, oversaturated copy of its contents outward as a glow.

meta.interaction: Static — the glow is taken from the content itself when the page loads and does not respond to input.

items.name: ballpit
items.title: Ballpit
items.description: Pit of glossy 3D spheres that pile up and bounce off the walls of the frame.

meta.interaction: The balls drop in and settle on load, then scatter whenever the pointer moves across the frame as one ball tracks the cursor and knocks the rest around.

items.name: bento
items.title: Bento
items.description: Bento grid of uneven tiles, each with an image, icon, title and short blurb, that link somewhere when clicked.

meta.interaction: Hovering a tile deepens its shadow and nudges the text block to the right; on the full-background tiles the caption slides up to make room for a link that fades in along the bottom, with its arrows lighting up in sequence.

items.name: blur-fade-theme-transition
items.title: Blur Fade Theme Transition
items.description: A simple and elegant theme provider that cross-fades and blurs between light and dark modes.

meta.interaction: Triggered programmatically. Smoothly cross-fades and blurs the screen during theme changes.

items.name: blur-scroll-reveal

items.name: blur-vignette
items.title: Blur Vignette

meta.interaction: Static — the blurred border is applied on load and does not respond to input.

items.name: bottom-blur

items.name: box-carousel

items.name: brick-breaker

items.name: card-deck

items.name: codeblock3
items.title: Codeblock3
items.description: Multi-tab code panel with a copy button, a scrollable snippet area and an underline marking the open tab.

items.name: collection-surfer
items.title: Collection Surfer

items.name: color-change-cards
items.title: Color Change Cards
items.description: Grid of photo tiles that sit desaturated behind a heading, a caption and a corner arrow.

meta.interaction: Hovering a tile brings its photo back to full colour and zooms it in, swings the corner arrow up to a diagonal, and rolls the heading letters upward one after another to a matching copy underneath.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Swatch button that opens a picker panel with a saturation field, a rainbow hue slider, a hex input and preset chips.
